title: Pin the snapshot launch-count tests to exactly one document process over a no-document baseline
outcome: Pin the snapshot launch-count tests to exactly one document process over a no-document baseline
acceptance: The cold snapshot, bounded snapshot and shared-publication export launch-count tests compare each snapshot read with a baseline that reads no task documents, and require exactly one more `git cat-file` start, so an extra fixed Git launch per snapshot (such as an unconditional --batch-check) fails them
